name: ChatGPT
tagline: The world's most popular AI assistant for writing, coding, and research.
description: ChatGPT by OpenAI is the gold standard for conversational AI. Use it to write essays, debug code, summarize documents, brainstorm ideas, and much more. The free tier (GPT-4o mini) is excellent for most everyday tasks.
pros: Best free tier in the market

name: Claude
tagline: Anthropic's AI — exceptional for long documents, coding, and nuanced reasoning.
description: Claude by Anthropic is known for its exceptionally long context window (200K tokens), strong reasoning, and safety-first design. Brilliant for reading entire PDFs, long codebases, and detailed analysis tasks.

name: Google Gemini
tagline: Google's multimodal AI — deeply integrated with Google Workspace.
description: Gemini is Google's flagship AI model, available free through Google's products. The free tier via gemini.google.com is excellent, and Gemini Advanced (via Google One) adds the most powerful Gemini Ultra model.

name: Microsoft Copilot
tagline: Microsoft's AI powered by GPT-4 — free in Windows, Edge, and Office.
description: Microsoft Copilot brings GPT-4 to Windows, Edge browser, and Microsoft 365. For Indian users with Microsoft 365 subscriptions (common in corporate environments), Copilot is an incredible free add-on.

name: Perplexity AI
tagline: AI-powered search engine — answers with real-time sources and citations.
description: Perplexity is the best AI search engine, providing cited answers from the real-time web. Perfect for research, fact-checking, and staying current. The free tier is very generous for Indian students.

name: Grammarly
tagline: AI writing assistant for grammar, clarity, tone, and plagiarism checks.
description: Grammarly is the go-to writing assistant for correcting grammar, improving clarity, adjusting tone, and detecting plagiarism. Essential for Indian students and professionals writing in English.

name: GitHub Copilot
tagline: AI pair programmer by GitHub — autocomplete, chat, and code generation.
description: GitHub Copilot is the gold standard for AI-assisted coding, trained on billions of lines of code. Free for verified students and open-source contributors. Essential for any serious developer.
pros: Free for GitHub Student Pack users
Works in VS Code, JetBrains, Vim

name: Cursor
tagline: The AI-first code editor — Claude and GPT-4 baked into VS Code.
description: Cursor is a VS Code fork with Claude and GPT-4 deeply integrated. Ask it to write, refactor, or explain entire files. The best AI coding experience for professional developers.

name: Codeium
tagline: Free AI code completion for 70+ languages — no usage limits.
description: Codeium offers free unlimited AI code completion for 70+ languages and 40+ editors. A fantastic alternative to GitHub Copilot for Indian developers who need a zero-cost solution with no strings attached.
pros: No account required for basic use

name: Ollama
tagline: Run LLMs locally on your Mac, Linux, or Windows — completely free, no internet needed.
description: Ollama lets you run Llama 3, Mistral, Gemma, Phi-3, and 100+ open-source AI models locally on your machine. No API costs, no internet required, complete privacy. The best option for Indian developers on slow or unreliable connections.

name: LM Studio
tagline: Beautiful desktop app to run local AI models — with built-in chat UI.
description: LM Studio is the most user-friendly way to run local LLMs. Download models from Hugging Face, chat with them in a clean UI, and expose a local API server — all for free, no internet needed during inference.

name: NotebookLM
tagline: Google's free AI research assistant — chat with your PDFs, docs, and notes.
description: NotebookLM by Google is a free AI-powered research tool that lets you upload PDFs, Google Docs, and web pages, then ask questions about them. Incredible for students analyzing research papers or textbooks.

name: Midjourney
tagline: The world's most artistic AI image generator — stunning results every time.
description: Midjourney produces the most visually stunning AI-generated images of any tool on the market. Used by designers, illustrators, and creatives worldwide. Requires a Discord account to use.

name: Stable Diffusion
tagline: Open-source AI image generation — runs locally, completely free.
description: Stable Diffusion is the open-source image generation model that powers hundreds of tools. Run it locally via AUTOMATIC1111 or ComfyUI — completely free with no API costs. Requires a GPU (6GB+ VRAM).

name: Canva AI
tagline: AI-powered design for everyone — templates, image gen, and video in one place.
description: Canva's AI features bring design within reach for non-designers. Magic Write for content, Text to Image for visuals, and Background Remover for clean edits — all inside Canva's familiar drag-and-drop editor.
cons: AI features limited on free tier

name: ElevenLabs
tagline: Realistic AI voice generation and cloning — best-in-class audio quality.
description: ElevenLabs produces the most realistic AI-generated voices available. Use it for voiceovers, podcasts, audiobooks, and dubbing. The voice cloning feature is incredibly powerful — clone any voice from 1 minute of audio.

name: Murf AI
tagline: Professional AI voiceovers — 120+ voices including Indian English accents.
description: Murf AI is a professional voiceover studio powered by AI. It's particularly popular in India for its Indian English accents, making it perfect for educational content, YouTube videos, and corporate presentations.

name: Whisper (OpenAI)
tagline: Open-source speech-to-text model — runs locally, near-perfect accuracy.
description: OpenAI Whisper is an open-source speech recognition model that runs locally on your machine. Near-perfect transcription accuracy for English and good support for Hindi and Indian languages. Completely free.

name: ChatPDF
tagline: Chat with any PDF instantly — perfect for research papers and textbooks.
description: ChatPDF lets you upload any PDF and ask questions about it in plain language. A favorite among Indian students for analyzing research papers, government documents, and NCERT textbooks.

name: Rytr
tagline: AI writing tool for freelancers — 40+ use cases, Indian pricing.
description: Rytr is an affordable AI writing assistant with over 40 use cases — blog posts, emails, social media, product descriptions, and more. Popular with Indian freelancers for its affordable monthly plan (₹600/mo).
pros: Most affordable paid plan in India

name: Suno AI
tagline: Generate full songs with vocals and music from a text prompt — free to try.
description: Suno AI is the breakthrough tool for AI music generation. Type a prompt like 'upbeat Bollywood pop song about monsoon' and Suno generates a complete song with vocals, instruments, and lyrics in minutes.

name: GPT4All
tagline: Free local AI chat app — runs on CPU, no GPU needed.
description: GPT4All is the most accessible local LLM app — it runs entirely on CPU, meaning even budget laptops can run AI models locally without an internet connection. Perfect for Indian users with older hardware.
cons: Basic UI compared to LM Studio

name: Aider
tagline: AI pair programmer in your terminal — works with Claude, GPT-4, Gemini.
description: Aider is an open-source AI coding assistant that runs in your terminal and can edit code across multiple files. It integrates with git, understands your codebase, and can use Claude, GPT-4, or Gemini as the backend.

name: Notion AI
tagline: AI-powered notes, docs, and project management — all in one workspace.
description: Notion AI brings AI writing and summarization directly into your Notion workspace. Draft docs, summarize notes, auto-fill databases, and brainstorm without switching tabs. Ideal for students and teams already using Notion.
pros: Works inside Notion — no context switching
AI writing in your notes and docs
Great for students and project planning
Free tier of Notion is already useful
cons: AI credits limited on free plan
Not as capable as ChatGPT standalone

name: Runway ML
tagline: Professional AI video generation and editing — text to video, image to video.
description: Runway ML is the professional standard for AI video generation. Convert text prompts or still images into cinematic video clips, remove backgrounds, and apply AI effects — all in the browser with no software install.

name: Adobe Firefly
tagline: Adobe's AI image generator — commercially safe, deep Creative Cloud integration.
description: Adobe Firefly is trained exclusively on licensed images, making it the safest AI image generator for commercial use. Deep integration with Photoshop (Generative Fill), Illustrator, and the broader Creative Cloud suite.

name: Jasper AI
tagline: AI marketing copy platform — 50+ templates for blogs, ads, emails, and social.
description: Jasper is an enterprise-grade AI writing platform purpose-built for marketing teams. With 50+ templates, brand voice consistency, and a campaigns feature, it's the go-to for marketing copy at scale.
cons: ChatGPT is cheaper for most tasks

name: Jan.ai
tagline: Open-source local LLM app — ChatGPT alternative that runs on your machine.
description: Jan.ai is an open-source desktop app for running LLMs locally with full privacy. It features a clean chat UI, Hugging Face model integration, and an OpenAI-compatible local API — all completely free, no internet needed after setup.
cons: Smaller model selection than LM Studio

name: AnythingLLM
tagline: Chat with your documents using local LLMs — private RAG without cloud costs.
description: AnythingLLM lets you chat with your own documents using a fully local RAG pipeline. Upload PDFs, text files, and more, then query them with any local model — Ollama, LM Studio, or cloud APIs. No data leaves your machine.
pros: Chat with your own documents locally

name: Consensus
tagline: AI-powered academic search — find what science actually says on any topic.
description: Consensus searches over 200 million academic papers and synthesizes AI-powered summaries of real scientific findings. The Consensus Meter shows how much scientific literature agrees or disagrees on a claim — invaluable for students and researchers.
pros: Filters by study type and year

name: Tabnine
tagline: AI code completion with a local privacy mode — your code never leaves your machine.
description: Tabnine provides AI-powered code completions with a unique local model option that keeps your code fully private. Supports 80+ programming languages and integrates with VS Code, IntelliJ, Vim, and more.
pros: Works offline with local model option
Privacy mode — code never leaves machine
cons: Weaker than Copilot on complex completions

name: Amazon CodeWhisperer
tagline: Amazon's free AI code assistant — built-in security scans and AWS integration.
description: Amazon CodeWhisperer is completely free for individual developers, offering AI code suggestions across 15 languages with a built-in security vulnerability scanner. Deep AWS service awareness makes it invaluable for cloud developers.
pros: Works in VS Code, JetBrains, Cloud9
cons: Weaker than Copilot on non-AWS code

name: Continue.dev
tagline: Open-source AI code assistant — works with any LLM including local Ollama models.
description: Continue.dev is a free, open-source AI coding extension for VS Code and JetBrains. Bring your own API key (Claude, GPT-4, Gemini) or point it at a local Ollama instance — no vendor lock-in, fully customizable.
indianPricing: ₹0 (bring your own API key or use local models)
pros: Works with Claude, GPT-4, Ollama, local models
Deep VS Code and JetBrains integration
cons: Needs API key or local model setup

name: Leonardo AI
tagline: AI image generation with 150 free tokens daily — fine-tuned models for every style.
description: Leonardo AI offers one of the most generous free tiers in AI image generation — 150 tokens every day, no subscription required. Choose from fine-tuned models optimized for game art, anime, photorealism, and more.
pros: Fine-tuned models for game art, anime, realism

name: Kling AI
tagline: Chinese AI video generator with the most generous free tier — 66 credits per day.
description: Kling AI from Kuaishou delivers high-quality AI video generation with an industry-leading free tier of 66 credits per day. Generate 5-second clips from text or images, with lip sync capabilities and watermark-free output on paid plans.

name: Replit AI
tagline: Browser-based coding with AI — no installation needed, deploy in one click.
description: Replit AI combines a full cloud IDE with AI coding assistance — no local setup required. Write, run, debug, and deploy apps entirely in the browser. Perfect for Indian students on shared or low-spec machines.
pros: Code in browser — no local setup needed
AI explains and fixes code inline
cons: AI features limited on free plan

name: Hugging Face
tagline: The GitHub of AI — 70,000+ free open-source models, datasets, and demo spaces.
description: Hugging Face is the central hub of the open-source AI ecosystem — hosting over 70,000 models, thousands of datasets, and free demo Spaces. Essential for AI researchers, students learning ML, and developers building on open models.
cons: Some models need paid GPU inference
